title: Exact stored tableau data
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $C,e,c,A,d,i$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. In the packed word formed from these data, the stored input length is $m=|x|+C(|x|+1)^e$, the stored horizon is $T=c\bigl(A(m+1)^d+1\bigr)^2$, the stored trajectory is the serialization of the first $T+1$ trajectory rows of $M$ on the all-false input of length $m$, and the stored visit table is the ordered list of the first $T+1$ visit rows for $M,C,e,x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
replaced: For every source machine, parameters, instance $x$, and cursor $i$, the stored input length is $m = |x| + C(|x|+1)^e$, the stored horizon is the producer horizon $T$, the stored trajectory is the inclusive serialized trajectory of $T+1$ rows over the all-false input of length $m$, and the stored visit table is the ordered table of $T+1$ visit rows.
